cases.purpose: Two controlled tmpfs filesystems: compare total block and inode values and total-row target with and without a source field.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 df(1) on the reference side, same guest and per-side mounts
cases.comparison: Byte parity with GNU df; setup and in-namespace mount controls must succeed before data are collected.
cases.setup_script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
mkdir a b
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '. ./mounts.sh && /usr/bin/python3 fsobs.py mounts "[[\"fa\", \"tmpfs\", \"a\"], [\"fb\", \"tmpfs\", \"b\"]]"'

files.mounts.sh:
/usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs -o size=1M,nr_inodes=64 fa a || exit 97
/usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs -o size=4M,nr_inodes=128 fb b || exit 97
files.inner.sh:
set -e
. ./mounts.sh
/usr/bin/python3 fsobs.py mounts '[["fa", "tmpfs", "a"], ["fb", "tmpfs", "b"]]'
/usr/bin/python3 fsobs.py fill a/x 12288
/usr/bin/python3 fsobs.py fill b/x 1048576
for fields in target,size,used,avail,pcent source,target,size,used,avail,pcent target,itotal,iused,iavail,ipcent; do
  printf '[%s]\n' "$fields"
  df --total --output="$fields" a b
done
